body: China Airlines reported record first-nine-months results, with consolidated revenue of NT$185.94 billion, operating profit of NT$15.774 billion, after-tax net profit of NT$12.624 billion, net profit attributable to the parent company of NT$11.002 billion, and earnings per share of NT$1.8. Both revenue and profit set new highs for the first nine months of a year. Third-quarter revenue reached NT$65.125 billion, net profit NT$4.929 billion, and earnings per share NT$0.72, also records for a third quarter.

Passenger revenue drove the result. First-nine-months passenger revenue was NT$106.786 billion, up 14.35% year on year, and third-quarter passenger revenue was NT$36.542 billion, up 22.4%, boosted by summer holiday travel demand. The airline added Airbus A350-900s and A321neos this year to grow capacity, its Boeing 787s are about to be delivered, and 18 A350-900s will be retrofitted starting next year.

Cargo was the other engine. First-nine-months cargo revenue was NT$62.908 billion, up 29.16% year on year, driven by high-value cargo such as AI servers and semiconductor equipment, while third-quarter cargo revenue was NT$22.729 billion, up 37.47%. Looking to the fourth quarter, the airline expects the year-end shopping season in Europe and the United States to drive restocking of general cargo and e-commerce goods, supporting continued strong air cargo demand.
en.summary: China Airlines posted record first-nine-months revenue of NT$185.94 billion and earnings per share of NT$1.8, with revenue and profit both at all-time highs for the period; passenger and cargo revenue set records together.
en.title: China Airlines posts record first-nine-months revenue of NT$185.94 billion, EPS of NT$1.8

body: 中華航空公告前3季財報，合併營收1859.4億元、合併營業淨利157.74億元、合併稅後淨利126.24億元、歸屬母公司淨利110.02億元、每股盈餘1.8元，前3季營收及淨利雙創歷年同期新高。第3季營收651.25億元、淨利49.29億元、每股盈餘0.72元，也寫下歷年同期新高。
客運是成長主引擎。受惠今年暑期旅遊旺季需求，前3季客運收入1067.86億元、年增14.35%，第3季客運收入365.42億元、年成長22.4%，前3季及第3季客運營收同寫紀錄。華航今年引進A350-900及A321neo等客機增加運能，787客機也即將交付；明年起18架A350-900將陸續改艙。
貨運是另一具引擎。前3季貨運收入629.08億元、年增29.16%，主要受AI伺服器、半導體機台等高附加價值貨源持續暢旺帶動；第3季貨運營收227.29億元、成長37.47%。展望第4季，迎接歐美年終購物季，可望帶動傳產、電商等其他空運主力產品鋪貨潮，預期支撐整體貨運需求續強。
zh.summary: 中華航空公告前3季財報，合併營收1859.4億元、每股盈餘1.8元，營收與淨利雙創歷年同期新高；客運與貨運收入同步寫下紀錄。
zh.title: 華航前3季營收1859.4億元、每股賺1.8元，營收與淨利同創同期新高
